title: Head positions during the move sweep
statement: Let $\Gamma$ be a type with decidable equality, let $N,k\in\mathbb{N}$, let $E$ inject optional $\Gamma$-symbols into blocks of $N+1$ optional bits, and let $e:\{0,1\}\hookrightarrow\Gamma$ be an injection. For a binary word $x$, a configuration $c$ on its letterwise $e$-image, an action $a$, a move-sweep counter $r\in\{0,\ldots,N+1\}$, and a work tape $i<k$, the head position in the move-sweep configuration is either the position with block index equal to the original head position and some offset $j\le N+1$, or the position with block index equal to the head position after applying $a$ and some offset $j\le N+1$.
hypotheses_covered: $E$ is an injection from optional symbols to blocks
$e$ is an injection from bits to $\Gamma$
$c$ is a configuration on the letterwise $e$-image of $x$
